previous_reason_correction: The prior report compared programme/codec/player-suffix and described failures as missing formats. The correct identity comparison is host + programme + codec-bitrate. The player suffix is not a codec. This batch separately reviews newly matched references; the approved archive remains byte-exact and unchanged.
